name: ui-disconnect-reconnect
summary: Open Mods connected at `@site`, disconnect to the main menu (no Client_0), assert the workspace closed and modsCapture released, wait for the Core inventory-cleared line and status showing the server list unavailable, reconnect to 127.0.0.1:9976, wait for the inventory-restored handshake-ok line, then measure settings-lock recovery from that line to the first authoritative readback. Do not prime with shortcut.
notes: Acceptance procedure — not run. Start connected to the isolated test server (ports 9976/9977). `--side client`. Open steps use `site` `@site` (`--site`; omitted, main-menu with no Client_0, top-tab when connected). `disconnect` requests the production ExitGame view (pending is not completion). Poll client ping until worlds has no Client_0. Do not close-to-prime, do not open site=shortcut.

After leave: wait (bounded) for the client Core line `Mods inventory: server context cleared reason=disconnect` (`inventoryCleared`, sinceRecord on the disconnect op). Then mods_ui status must show the workspace closed (`after.open` false, `after.modsCapture` false) — the product requirement under test. `after.serverList.state` is `unavailable` after that clear. `after.entries` are sidebar rows (`id` / `name` / `status` / `location` / `version` / `requirement`; `status` is Running / Loaded on this client / Reported on this client / Listed by server). The overview sentence `Server mod list unavailable` is `ModMenuInventory.Snapshot().ServerSummary`, not copied onto status.

`connect` to 127.0.0.1:9976 (default SteamIPv4). If this test server is LanMode-only, pass protocol Lidgren on that step. Join is async: poll ping until Client_0, then server users until connected=true and handshake=ok.

After reconnect: wait for `Mods inventory: server context restored reason=handshake-ok` (`inventoryRestored`, sinceRecord on the connect op). Then mods_ui status must show `after.serverList.state` `available`. Reopen with the same `@site` (not shortcut). Poll Server settings widget_read until source admin (`firstAuthoritative`). Recovery ms is firstAuthoritative.seenAt minus inventoryRestored.seenAt. Uninterrupted locking is not claimed; do not inflate the interval with shortcut or attach priming.
Synced rows readable and the ExampleLimit admin editor source=admin after recovery. Intended finals: connected, workspace closed, curtain/input released, panes 0.
